messages:
adele: heads-up — noticed a perf regression on the non-chat embeddings/reranker endpoint after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. p99 for 1k-query batch jumped from ~120ms -> ~220ms.
adele: repro looks stable in staging. this only affects non-chat (single-turn) loads, chat endpoints fine.
adele: quick profiler dump (staging, 8xA10g):
```
# cpu-wall (ms):
total  220ms
kernel_select  32ms  (+20ms vs baseline)
matmul_gemm     90ms
kv_build        12ms
copy_to_device  18ms
other           68ms
```
adele: interestingly kernel_select time is higher and we see more `kv_build` despite non-chat. might be a batching formation issue causing extra KV merges.
raj: hmm. we changed the kernel heuristic to favor fused attention when seq_len >= 64 and token_budget_target relaxed. non-chat workloads usually seq_len ~ 16-64, so maybe it's picking a slower path for short sequences.
raj: can you paste the batcher queue snapshot?
adele: copied from the queue API at the moment of repro:
```
{
  "queue_depth": 512,
  "avg_seq_len": 28,
  "token_budget_target": 12000,
  "max_batch_tokens": 32768,
  "prefer_fast_kernels": false,
  "kv_cache_mode": "auto"
}
```
adele: note `prefer_fast_kernels:false` — that's from the new global policy.
marta: ran a quick A/B: reverting `prefer_fast_kernels` -> true drops p99 back to ~130ms.
marta: also saw fewer `kv_build` spikes (down to 3ms).
raj: so two things: the heuristic switch and token_budget_target increase cause batch assembly to pick batches that push sequence lengths into a codepath with slower kernels and unnecessary kv merges.
li: infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T09:20:12 applied config/global-kernel-policy:v2 -> v3 (author: raj)
infra-bot: canary traffic 10% on accounts with >10qps.
adele: proposal: add endpoint-type override for kernel selection + enforce `prefer_fast_kernels:true` for non-chat embedding/reranker endpoints. also tune `token_budget_target` down for single-turn workloads to avoid large batch padding.
raj: agreed. implement override in router: if endpoint.tags contains "non-chat" then kernel_policy = "fast-short-seq" and token_budget_target *= 0.6.
raj: I'll add an integration test that simulates 1k small-embed requests to catch regressions.
marta: I'll run a microbench for kernel_select with seq lens [8,16,32,64] and quant modes to validate selection thresholds.
adele: quick temp hotfix: revert global `prefer_fast_kernels` to true and throttle canary to 0.
li: rolling back canary now. infra-bot: rollback config/global-kernel-policy to v2 (actioned).
raj: follow-ups: (1) add endpoint override, (2) tune token budget heuristics based on observed seq_len distribution, (3) add perf alert for kernel_select time > 25ms for non-chat endpoints.
adele: created a short checklist in the incident board and linked the perf traces: https://redwood.internal/perf/1781005432
adele: thanks team, will post results after microbench. :thumbsup:
